requirements.text: В презентации 12 слайдов; это презентация для владельцев веломагазинов о размещении их велосипедов на площадке.
requirements.taskQuote: Make a 12-slide sales deck for bike-shop owners about listing their bikes on our marketplace.

requirements.text: В презентации есть цифры посещаемости из выгрузки аналитики.
requirements.taskQuote: our traffic numbers from the analytics export

requirements.text: В презентации есть два примера клиентов.
Слайды читаются на экране ноутбука и в чёрно-белой распечатке.
requirements.taskQuote: Slides must be readable on a laptop screen and when printed in black and white.

requirements.text: Цвета бренда и логотип есть на каждом слайде.
requirements.taskQuote: Use our brand colours and logo on every slide.

lenses.title: Числа против данных
lenses.duty: Найти каждое число, значение на графике, цену или факт о клиенте на слайдах, которые расходятся с выгрузкой аналитики, прайсом или источниками.
procedure: List every number on every slide: traffic, growth, prices, customer results.
Find each number in the analytics export or the price list and recompute any derived figure (growth, sums, shares).
Check that chart bars, labels and axis values match the numbers they show.
Check customer example facts against the sources and record each command.
checklist: Does every traffic number match the analytics export for the stated period?
Are derived figures (growth, shares, sums) computed correctly?
Do chart values and labels match the data?
Does every price match the price list?
Are customer example facts supported by a source?
Is the same number stated the same way on every slide?

minimum.rule: Every row of the analytics export used by a slide.
Every number on every slide image.
Check customer example facts against the sources.

lenses.title: Читаемость и бренд на каждом слайде
lenses.duty: Найти каждый слайд, который трудно прочитать на экране ноутбука или в чёрно-белой распечатке, и каждый слайд, где элементы бренда отличаются от остальных или пропали.
procedure: Open every slide image at laptop size and check text size, contrast and hierarchy.
Convert or view every slide in greyscale and check that charts and highlighted text still read without colour.
Put all slides side by side and compare the logo, footer, colours and fonts of each slide with its neighbours; a slide whose logo or footer differs or is missing is a finding.
Read the deck source for layouts that the images do not show (overflowing text, hidden elements).
checklist: Is text large enough and contrasted enough on a laptop screen?
Do charts and highlights still read in black and white?
Is the logo present and identical on every slide?
Are brand colours and fonts used consistently?
Is anything cut off, overlapping or overflowing?

minimum.rule: Open every slide image and compare logos and footers across all slides side by side.
The deck source: every slide's layout.

lenses.title: Довод для продажи
lenses.duty: Найти каждый пробел или противоречие в доводах, которые нужны владельцу магазина, чтобы решиться размещать велосипеды на площадке.
procedure: Read the deck in order as a shop owner who has never heard of the marketplace, and write down the question each slide answers.
Note which questions a shop owner would ask that no slide answers (cost, effort, results, contract terms).
Check that the customer examples support the claims they are attached to.
Check that the last slide gives a clear next step.
checklist: Does the deck answer what the shop owner gets, what it costs and what effort it takes?
Do the customer examples support the claims next to them?
Is the order of slides logical?
Is there a clear call to action with contact details?
Do any two slides contradict each other?

lenses.title: Первый читатель
lenses.duty: Прочитать всю работу как человек, у которого есть только задание владельца, и найти, где работа не даёт того, что просили, трудна для понимания или в ней нет чего-то нужного.
procedure: Read the owner's task and list everything it asks for.
Read every file of the work once, start to end.
For each thing the task asks for, find where the work delivers it, and note what is missing or only partly there.
checklist: Is every requirement of the task delivered?
Is the slide count right?
Do the parts of the work agree with each other?
Is anything required missing?
Is anything confusing on first reading?

minimum.rule: Read every file once, start to end.
